_source: Updated 2026-10-28 (launch day) to reconcile with the 2026-10-27 tracker sync: 54 live partners. Delta vs 2026-10-26 (53 / 37574): +1 partner (Zapier, newly Live), +$0 - Zapier is a free 2-week trial with no CAN-exclusive dollar savings (per Avi 10/7/26, v:null in cansw-data), so it joins the count like the uncapped-earn rows but never enters the total. total_value_exact stays 37574; display string stays $37,000+. Uncapped-earn rows (ShopYourLikes, Insense, TopFan) still count as live partners with no dollar contribution. Largest single discount remains $7,200 (CreatorCare); smallest $30 (Elevate.io). total_value_exact is required - without it the widget stat tile silently falls back to the rounded figure. segments/segments_updated untouched (still the 2026-09-10 out-of-band write at 50 partners; needs its own refresh). 2026-10-28 (second edit, out of band): Greenroom Legal's ceiling corrected 2000 -> 3200 after the partner confirmed the figure by email on 10/27 (the earlier 2000 omitted the 5%-off-next-three-hourly-projects tier); ceiling total 37574 -> 38774, which moves the rounded display from $37,000+ to $38,000+. Note this delta was applied by hand, not recomputed by the parser - the next parser run should confirm 38774. Greenroom's name was also corrected to the partner's required spelling (lowercase r) in cansw-data.json, its logos map, segments.json and segments-live.json. 2026-10-28 (third edit, out of band): VidSummit and CreatorIQ REMOVED from the network - both were one-time event offers whose events have passed (VidSummit Sep 29-Oct 1, CreatorIQ Connect Oct 13) and both were moved to the removed section of the tracker. Partner count 54 -> 52. Ceiling 38774 -> 38674 (VidSummit contributed $100; CreatorIQ already contributed $0 as a one-time ticket). Rounded display stays $38,000+. Their rows were also cleared from the events strip in segments.json / segments-live.json, which now renders nothing. 2026-11-02 (weekly parser run): the parser recomputed from OFFER TRACKING and independently confirmed 52 live partners and ceiling 38674, so all three out-of-band 2026-10-28 edits are verified and no value changed this run. The 10/28 note asked the next parser run to confirm 38774; that figure is superseded by 38674 once VidSummit (-$100) and CreatorIQ ($0) left the live table. Greenroom Legal parses at 3200. Partner count is DOWN 1 vs the 2026-10-26 run (53 -> 52), which compute.py flags as a warning, not a block. segments and segments_updated untouched. 2026-11-03 (out of band): partner_count 52 -> 55 and ceiling 38674 -> 39736 (display $38,000+ -> $39,000+). Adds Sisters Matcha (Tiger Sisters) at $12 (added to cansw-data.json by the 11/3 sync without a numbers.json bump), Hostinger at $150 (CAN-computed: 25% x 12 months of Hostinger's published renewal rates, Premium $10.99/mo = $33 up to VPS KVM 8 $49.99/mo = $150; Hostinger publishes only 48-month promo pricing, so partner confirmation of the figure is pending), and Greet at $900 (partner-reported: Greets sell $30-$50 to 20-30 fans = $600-$1,500 per Greet; fees waived on the first two = 30% x 2 x $1,500).
